# testdata/export moves to shared/, and a symbolic link to ../shared/export.d takes its place

    testdata/ holds no symbolic links: testdata/export is one, so the update wrote nothing.
        Remove it, or replace it with a copy of what it names, if it names anything, then run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... again.
